evidence.text: The owner requires an AI assistant to guide a person through configuring every secret and setting for an application across all environments.
To guide well, the assistant must know for each key whether a value exists, is a placeholder, is malformed, or is valid.
The owner forbids any secret value, or anything from which part of it can be recovered, from reaching the assistant or any language model.
opv already holds values only in process memory in a redacting, zeroized type, and a canary scan checks every output for test markers.

desiredImprovement: The assistant's knowledge of each value's condition, so it can guide the person precisely
worseningOutcome: Confidentiality of secret values: every extra fact about a value leaks information to a language model
element: information about a stored secret value
